Recomputed FROM THE SHIPPED CARD by ac6 itself, which cross-checks this handoff value against the card bytes.

verification_commands.ac6:
set -u
# ac6 - PURITY + REPRODUCIBILITY against the BRANCH BASE, DERIVED AT RUN TIME.
# Read-only. The base is derived from the BRANCH SHAPE, never from a
# main-tip-at-groom literal: the groom-INGEST commit (this card + the groom
# handoff + one WAL line) always sits between the groom-time main tip and any
# base a builder can legally hold, so a pinned tip drags
# docs/log/orchestrator_wal.jsonl - a path the builder must NEVER touch - into a
# delta nobody can remove. That was t102's structurally un-greenable ac6 (WAL
# 1221/1222) and it is why the derivation below prints its candidates, its
# rejections and its acceptance. The WAL is deliberately NOT admitted to ALLOWED:
# it sits BELOW the branch base, so if it ever appears inside a branch delta, RED
# is the correct verdict. Nothing is quoted: the ac_hash is RECOMPUTED from the
# shipped card, so a single edited character in any fence is caught here.
test -f docs/issues/t103.md || { echo "ac6 RED: this card is missing - run from the repository root"; exit 1; }
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ac6 RED: python3 missing"; exit 1; }
python3 - <<'PYAC6' || exit 1
import hashlib, json, os, re, subprocess, sys
CARD = "docs/issues/t103.md"
GROOM = "docs/state/outputs/t103_definer_groom.json"
# The builder handoff is named explicitly (the t102 amendment lesson): the card's
# own Definition of Done requires it ON THE BRANCH, so it is part of the card's
# named surface rather than a stray. ONE literal path - no glob, no directory,
# and NOT docs/log/orchestrator_wal.jsonl (see the header comment).
BUILDER = "docs/state/outputs/t103_builder_build.json"
OWNED = ["docs/criteria/agent_pack_verification.md", "docs/criteria/req_coverage_verification.md"]
FROZEN_NEIGHBOURS = ["docs/state/merge_test_index.json", "docs/commands.md", ".gitignore",
                     "README.md", "openapi.yaml", "docs/criteria/docs_verification.md",
                     "docs/criteria/dashboard_verification.md", "docs/criteria/infra_verification.md",
                     "docs/criteria/security_ops_verification.md",
                     "backend/scripts/agent_pack_verification.py",
                     "backend/scripts/req_coverage_verification.py"]
KEYS = ("GIT_DIR", "GIT_WORK_TREE", "GIT_INDEX_FILE", "GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY",
        "GIT_COMMON_DIR", "GIT_PREFIX")
def fail(m):
    sys.stderr.write("ac6 RED: " + m + "\n"); raise SystemExit(1)
def cr(b):
    return b.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")
def env():
    return {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k not in KEYS}
def git(args):
    p = subprocess.run(["git"] + args, capture_output=True, env=env())
    return cr(p.stdout or b""), (p.stderr or b"").decode("utf-8", "replace"), p.returncode
def blob(rev_, path):
    out, err, _ = git(["show", "%s:%s" % (rev_, path)])
    if not out:
        w = subprocess.run(["wslpath", "-w", os.getcwd()], capture_output=True,
                           text=True, env=env()).stdout.strip().replace("\r\n", "\n")
        out, err, _ = git(["cmd.exe", "/d", "/c", "git -C %s show %s:%s" % (w, rev_, path)])
    if not out:
        fail("blob %s:%s unreadable through WSL git AND cmd.exe git (%s)" % (rev_, path, err[:120]))
    return out
def rev(spec):
    out, _, rc = git(["rev-parse", "--revs-only", spec])
    r = out.decode("utf-8", "replace").strip()
    return r if rc == 0 and r else ""
def merge_base(ref):
    if not rev(ref):
        return ""
    out, _, rc = git(["merge-base", ref, "HEAD"])
    b = out.decode("utf-8", "replace").strip()
    return b if rc == 0 and b else ""
def blob_at(rev_, path):
    probe, _, rc = git(["rev-parse", "--verify", "-q", "%s:%s" % (rev_, path)])
    if rc != 0 or not probe.strip():
        return None
    return blob(rev_, path)
def rejection(cand):
    if not cand:
        return "unresolvable on this checkout"
    if cand == rev("HEAD"):
        return "is HEAD itself, not a base"
    _, _, rc = git(["merge-base", "--is-ancestor", cand, "HEAD"])
    if rc != 0:
        return "is not an ancestor of HEAD"
    for p in OWNED:
        at = blob_at(cand, p)
        head = blob_at("HEAD", p)
        if at is not None and head is not None and at == head:
            return "%s already equals its HEAD blob there - that commit carries this card's product, so diffing against it would make the delta vacuous; the branch looks already merged or replayed" % p
    return ""
CANDIDATES = [("HEAD^ (the branch parent)", rev("HEAD^")),
              ("merge-base(main, HEAD)", merge_base("main")),
              ("merge-base(origin/main, HEAD)", merge_base("origin/main"))]
BASE = BASE_LABEL = ""
for label, cand in CANDIDATES:
    if BASE:
        print("ac6 evidence: base candidate %s -> %s not tested (the base is already resolved)" % (label, cand[:7] or "(none)"))
        continue
    why = rejection(cand)
    if why:
        print("ac6 evidence: base candidate %s -> %s rejected: %s" % (label, cand[:7] or "(none)", why))
    else:
        BASE, BASE_LABEL = cand, label
        print("ac6 evidence: base candidate %s -> %s ACCEPTED (strict pre-product ancestor of HEAD)" % (label, cand[:7]))
if not BASE:
    fail("no candidate base (%s) is a strict pre-product ancestor of HEAD - the branch is not in the (base -> product -> handoff) shape this card assumes, so the purity base cannot be derived; name the branch shape and re-groom rather than pin a literal" % ", ".join(l for l, _ in CANDIDATES))
print("ac6 evidence: PURITY BASE = %s derived from %s - the groom-INGEST commit sits BELOW this base, which is why docs/log/orchestrator_wal.jsonl cannot legitimately appear in this delta and is deliberately NOT in ALLOWED" % (BASE[:7], BASE_LABEL))
def names(args):
    out, err, rc = git(args)
    if rc != 0:
        fail("git %s failed: %s" % (" ".join(args), err[:160]))
    return [p for p in out.decode("utf-8", "replace").split("\n") if p.strip()]
tracked_delta = sorted(set(names(["diff", "--name-only", BASE])
                           + names(["diff", "--name-only", "--cached", BASE])))
ALLOWED = set(OWNED + [CARD, GROOM, BUILDER])
extra = sorted(set(tracked_delta) - ALLOWED)
if extra:
    fail("the delta touches %s beyond the two owned documents, this card and the two handoffs this card's Definition of Done requires - the refresh ships regenerated evidence bytes and nothing else" % ", ".join(extra))
print("ac6 evidence: delta against %s is exactly: %s" % (BASE[:7], ", ".join(tracked_delta) if tracked_delta else "(nothing)"))
POLLUTION_ROOTS = ("scratch", "build", "node_modules", ".venv", ".pytest_cache",
                   ".pi-agent", "__pycache__")
untracked = names(["ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard"])
strays, exc = [], []
for p in untracked:
    if any(root in p.split("/") for root in POLLUTION_ROOTS) or p.endswith(".pyc"):
        exc.append(p)
    elif p.startswith("docs/state/") and not p.endswith(".md"):
        exc.append(p)  # orchestrator bookkeeping and later-phase handoffs are not
                       # this card's surface; a stray DOCUMENT under docs/state/ is not exempt
    elif p not in ALLOWED:
        strays.append(p)
if strays:
    fail("untracked paths sit outside the owned surface and outside the two named exception classes (session pollution roots; pre-existing non-markdown artifacts under docs/state/): %s" % ", ".join(sorted(strays)[:12]))
print("ac6 evidence: untracked screen - %d paths in the pollution-root class, %d pre-existing orchestrator artifacts under docs/state/, zero strays" % (len(exc), len([p for p in exc if p.startswith("docs/state/")])))
missing = sorted(set(OWNED) - set(tracked_delta))
if missing:
    fail("%s is/are NOT in the delta against %s - the refresh has not been committed on this branch" % (", ".join(missing), BASE[:7]))
not_applied = [p for p in OWNED if cr(blob(BASE, p)) == cr(open(p, "rb").read())]
if not_applied:
    fail("%s still equal their %s blobs in the WORKING tree - the refresh is not applied in this checkout (a builder that never ran, or a revert of it, looks exactly like this)" % (", ".join(not_applied), BASE[:7]))
for p in FROZEN_NEIGHBOURS:
    if not os.path.isfile(p):
        fail("%s vanished from the tree" % p)
    b, w = cr(blob(BASE, p)), cr(open(p, "rb").read())
    if b != w:
        fail("%s differs from its %s blob (base %s vs work %s) - the index, docs/commands.md, .gitignore, README, openapi, the four carried reports and both generators are FROZEN for this card" % (p, BASE[:7], hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()[:12], hashlib.sha256(w).hexdigest()[:12]))
print("ac6 evidence: %d frozen neighbours byte-identical to their %s blobs" % (len(FROZEN_NEIGHBOURS), BASE[:7]))
card = cr(open(CARD, "rb").read()).decode("utf-8")
blocks = re.findall(r"(?ms)^### (ac\d+) - .*?^```bash\n(.*?)^```\n", card)
if not blocks:
    fail("no fenced bash blocks found in the shipped card - the ac_hash cannot be recomputed, which means the card's fences were not shipped as groomed")
ids = [b[0] for b in blocks]
if len(blocks) != 6 or ids != ["ac1", "ac2", "ac3", "ac4", "ac5", "ac6"]:
    fail("the shipped card carries %d fences %s, not the six in ac1..ac6 order - the ac_hash is defined over exactly six fenced blocks in order" % (len(blocks), ids))
bodies = [b[1].replace("\r", "").strip() for b in blocks]
digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(bodies, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("ac6 evidence: recomputed ac_hash from the shipped fences = %s (t58 recipe: sha256 over the JSON array of the six fenced bash bodies, COMPACT separators, each CR-stripped and trimmed)" % digest)
if not os.path.isfile(GROOM):
    fail("%s missing - the ac_hash cannot be cross-checked and Gate 1 has nothing to read" % GROOM)
if not os.path.isfile(BUILDER):
    fail("%s is NOT on this branch - the Definition of Done requires the builder handoff alongside the regenerated documents, and ac6 names it in ALLOWED precisely so the branch is checked for it. A refreshed report with no handoff leaves Gate 1 with nothing to read (the t102 amendment lesson: name the required handoff artifacts, then look for them)" % BUILDER)
h = json.loads(cr(open(GROOM, "rb").read()).decode("utf-8"))
hval = str(h.get("evidence", {}).get("ac_hash", "")).split(":")[-1].strip()
if hval != digest:
    fail("the groom handoff carries ac_hash %s but the shipped fences recompute to %s - the card was edited after grooming, or the hash was not authored from these bytes" % (hval[:16] or "(absent)", digest[:16]))
print("ac6 evidence: groom handoff ac_hash matches the recomputed digest")
vc = h.get("evidence", {}).get("verification_commands", {})
bad = [i for i, b in zip(ids, bodies) if cr(str(vc.get(i, "")).encode()).decode().strip() != b]
if bad:
    fail("handoff evidence.verification_commands differ from the shipped fences for %s - Builder and Verifier read the handoff, so a divergence means they would run different commands than the ones that were hashed" % bad)
print("ac6 evidence: handoff verification_commands are byte-identical to the six shipped fences")
print("ac6 GREEN: DELTA PURE AND GROOM REPRODUCIBLE - the delta against %s is exactly %s, %d frozen neighbours are byte-identical to their base blobs, the six shipped fences recompute to the handoff's ac_hash (%s), and the handoff's verification commands are byte-identical to those fences" % (BASE[:7], ", ".join(os.path.basename(p) for p in tracked_delta), len(FROZEN_NEIGHBOURS), digest[:12]))
PYAC6

evidence.verification_commands_source: byte-identical to the six fenced bash blocks in docs/issues/t103.md (generated FROM the shipped card by this handoff's own generator, not retyped); ac6 re-asserts the byte equality
evidence.builder_base_ref: a1d5193e3534da6c395c9fd8bd405a6b08bae253 (main tip at groom; the branch parent is what the fences derive at run time)
evidence.base_pinning_policy: NO PINNED MAIN-TIP BASE. t103 and t104 both derive their purity/frozenness base at run time from the branch shape (HEAD^ first, then merge-base(main,HEAD), then merge-base(origin/main,HEAD)), printing every candidate, its rejection reason and the acceptance. This handoff records the groom tip as PROVENANCE ONLY. The t102 lesson (WAL 1221/1222): a pinned groom-time tip sits ABOVE the groom-ingest commit, so the builder's delta against it necessarily contains docs/log/orchestrator_wal.jsonl - a path the builder must never touch - making ac6 structurally un-greenable.
evidence.card_shape: ASCII-only (0 non-ASCII bytes), 876 lines, 8 level-2 sections, exactly 6 fenced bash blocks each carrying a language tag, headings at depth <= ###, zero markdown-link regex matches, and the ac_hash carried as eight spaced groups with the full 64-hex held only in this handoff (no bare 64-hex literal in the card - the gitleaks generic-api-key FP class).
evidence.granularity: TWO committed documents, regenerated by their TWO OWNED GENERATORS, plus the two handoffs the Definition of Done requires. No product code, no test, no schema, no index change. Refreshing the other four criteria documents, editing either generator, and touching docs/state/merge_test_index.json are all explicitly Out of scope and each is named with the reason.

environment_facts_for_the_builder.agent_pack_generator: needs the pytest collection capture, so it runs through uv: cd backend && uv run pytest --collect-only -q | tr -d '\r' > COL, then PYTHONPATH=. uv run python scripts/agent_pack_verification.py --collection-file COL --ls-files-file LSF. Regenerate COL and LSF in the SAME shell call: a stale capture from an earlier call produced SYMLINK_ROWS mode120000=0 FAIL and ALL_CHECKS_PASS 19 FAIL during groom validation.
environment_facts_for_the_builder.crlf: core.autocrlf=true smudges committed LF blobs to CRLF in the working tree, so every byte comparison in the fences is CR-normalised.
environment_facts_for_the_builder.git_plumbing: fences scrub GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE/GIT_INDEX_FILE/GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY/GIT_COMMON_DIR/GIT_PREFIX on every git call; blob reads fall back to cmd.exe git when the WSL plumbing returns nothing (cmd.exe cannot reach WSL-native paths, so /tmp clones are WSL-git-only).
environment_facts_for_the_builder.generators_run_in_the_live_tree: with backup/restore of the two committed documents (the t102 ac3 precedent), never leaving a half-written report behind.

fence_smoke_tests.baseline: all six fences GREEN in a throwaway clone at the validated shape (ingest commit ec09ca1, builder branch t103-builder with the regenerated product commit 356a0a3); the base derived from HEAD^ and the acceptance was printed by each fence.
fence_smoke_tests.bite_matrix: 14 violation classes A..N all RED with the intended named reason: stale hand-edit of a committed document (ac1+ac2), generator tampering (ac1+ac5+ac6), DEFERRAL_REGISTER row count 3->4 (ac4 names the affected leg), non-deterministic regeneration (ac3), one-character fence edit (ac6 hash mismatch), handoff/card drift (ac6 byte-identity), a committed WAL line (ac6), and each frozen-neighbour and delta-purity mutation.
bugs_found_and_fixed_by_bite_testing: ac1 self-comparison vacuity: comparing post-regeneration bytes against themselves always passes, so ac1 now compares the PRE-regeneration committed bytes against fresh generator output AND against the HEAD blob (the refresh must be committed)
the PASS? status regex missed a state, fixed with a zero-aware tally
the REQ_ROW pointer regex was anchored and missed 2 of 749 rows (the DEFERRAL_RULLED rows carry trailing pairs); relaxed to an unanchored pointers=(\S+) capture and re-validated against all 749 rows
the git helper needed a 3-tuple return to carry returncode for the ancestor probe
base rejection needed the explicit not_applied working-tree check in addition to blob equality

negative_controls_executed: ac1 REDs on a planted hand-edit of the committed agent_pack document while the regenerated file is correct (proves the fence is not comparing regenerated bytes to themselves)
ac3 REDs when a second generator run yields different bytes (determinism is a real gate, not a decorative one)
ac4 REDs when the DEFERRAL_REGISTER row count is perturbed 3->4 and names the stored leg that would break
ac6 REDs on a one-character edit to any fenced block (the shipped hash is recomputed, not quoted) and on a handoff whose verification_commands differ from the card
ac6 REDs when docs/log/orchestrator_wal.jsonl appears in the delta (the path is deliberately absent from ALLOWED)
evidence.builder_base_ref_note: the builder works from the main tip; the fences never use it as a purity base - they derive HEAD^ or a merge-base at run time and print which one was used.
evidence.wal_exclusion: docs/log/orchestrator_wal.jsonl is deliberately EXCLUDED from the ALLOWED set. It sits below the branch base, so if it ever appears inside a branch delta the correct answer is RED, and no builder can legitimately remove it from a delta computed against a pinned groom-time tip - which is the t102 trap.
evidence.sibling_isolation: t104 owns .gitignore, docs/commands.md, the leg-pin checker and the findings record; t103 freezes all four by bytes and shares no path with t104, so the two cards may run in either order or together.
evidence.deferred_platform_body_sync: issue #109 body sync is deferred the way t99/t100 deferred theirs: the platform normalizer strips the body on issue get, so the pointer body was posted at survey and the full card body is not retrievable through the client. The card in docs/issues/ is the authority.
